scenario: RE2-class engine per LREG.8.4 — backreferences (`\1`, `\2`, `\k<name>`) are not supported and must be compile errors. Pin: `/^(\w+)\1/` (numeric backreference `\1`) rejects with DS_VALIDATE_REGEX_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

rule r:
    Log e where e.msg ~ /^(\w+)\1/
->
    log info "matched"
